question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025, which Angel Funds are required to mandatorily carry out annual PPM audit, and from which financial year?

answer.text: All Angel Funds, from FY 2023-24 onwards
Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 50 crore, from FY 2024-25 onwards
Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 100 crore, from FY 2025-26 onwards
Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 500 crore, from FY 2026-27 onwards

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.2 and footnote 139, Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 100 crore are required to mandatorily carry out annual audit of compliance with terms of PPM from FY 2025-26 onwards (per SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/AFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/128 dated September 10, 2025). The Trap: Historically Angel Funds were fully exempt from PPM audit — the 2025 circular creates a threshold-based obligation. INR 50 / 500 crore are incorrect thresholds. FY24-25 and FY26-27 are distractors. Cross-Exam Context: This is a brand-new regulatory point (Sep 2025) — XIX-C updated study material is the only place it's tested. XIX-A distributor material may lag on this. Manager's Pro-Tip: If you run an Angel Fund approaching INR 100 cr cost-basis investments, start building the audit framework a year in advance — finding an auditor familiar with Angel Fund specifics takes time.
